meta.name: who-decides
meta.description: Map stakeholders, decision rights, influence and blockers from supplied evidence. Use when ownership is unclear or the stakeholder landscape changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理相关方权责,标出谁拍板、谁影响、谁可能挡路,让决策不再悬空
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队里没人说得清某件事到底该谁拍板。
copy.tagline_en: Map who decides, who influences, and who can block, so stalled calls get unstuck
copy.fit_line_en: For you if no one can say who owns the final call.

howto.what: 根据你提供的材料,Claude 会梳理出相关方名单、各自的决策权、影响力与阻碍者,产出角色与决定权的对应关系;它保留未知项,也不重启已经答过的调研。
howto.when: 当归属不清、或相关方格局发生变化时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则沿用其当前的脱敏信息包与范围。

say.text: 这是我的项目背景材料,帮我列出谁有决策权、谁可能阻碍。
say.note: 会输出相关方、决策权与阻碍者清单。

say.text: 团队最近换了负责人,重新梳理一下相关方的决策归属。
say.note: 适用于格局变化后更新梳理。

say.text: 这几份会议记录里,谁在拍板、谁只是执行?
say.note: 从材料中区分决策者与执行者。

howto.what_en: From the materials you supply, Claude maps the stakeholders, their decision rights, influence and blockers, and produces a role-to-decision view. It preserves unknowns and does not restart discovery already answered.
howto.when_en: Use when ownership is unclear or the stakeholder landscape changes. If invoked by @fde, it reuses that current sanitized packet and scope instead of redoing answered questions.

say_en.text: Here's my project background - list who holds decision rights and who may block.
say_en.note: Produces a stakeholder, decision-rights and blocker list.

say_en.text: Our team just changed leads; re-map stakeholders' decision ownership.
say_en.note: Updates the map after a landscape change.

say_en.text: From these meeting notes, who actually decides and who just executes?
